description: NaDy(WO₄)₂ is Zircon-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.48 Å) and four longer (2.51 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Dy is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.39 Å) and four longer (2.41 Å) Dy-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All W-O bond lengths are 1.83 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All W-O bond lengths are 1.83 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Dy, and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Dy, and one W atom.
